description: This file manages Feishu app access tokens, including fetching, refreshing, and handling app tickets with retry logic and Prisma database updates.

methods.name: makePoolingPromise
methods.description: Retries a promise creator function multiple times with delay until success or attempts exhausted.

methods.name: getValidAppKeys
methods.description: Retrieves and validates app keys from external source.

methods.name: getAppTicketFromKeys
methods.description: Extracts app ticket from validated app keys.

methods.name: getAppTicket
methods.description: Obtains the app ticket, triggering resend if necessary, with retry logic.

methods.name: getAppAccessToken
methods.description: Main function to get a valid app access token, refreshing it if expired or invalid.
